name: Cleansing Hands
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level adept 4, alchemist 4, cleric/oracle 4, druid 5, inquisitor 4, paladin 3, shaman 5, white necromancer 4, witch .

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser cleansing hands except it heals 3d8 + your caster level (maximum +15) and in addition to the previous list of conditions, you can remove the blinded, dazed, deafened, diseased, exhausted, nauseated, and poisoned conditions. Instead of removing one of the conditions, you may remove all ability damage to one ability score.
